English

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
parking
Wikipedia

Etymology

[edit]

From park +‎ -ing.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Received Pronunciation) IPA(key): /ˈpɑː.kɪŋ/
  • (General American) IPA(key): /ˈpɑɹ.kɪŋ/
    • Audio (US):(file)
  • (Indic) IPA(key): /ˈpɑ(r).kɪnɡ/, [päː(ɾ).kɪŋɡ]
  • Rhymes: -ɑː(ɹ)kɪŋ
  • Hyphenation: park‧ing

Verb

[edit]

parking

  1. present participle and gerund of park
    Parking a car in a tight spot gave him some satisfaction. (as gerund)
    His parking skills needed improvement. (as participial adjective)
    They will be parking the aircraft in the desert for the next few months. (as progressive)

Noun

[edit]

parking (usually uncountable, plural parkings)

  2. The action of the verb to park.
    free parking
    Hyponyms: parallel parking, angle parking, echelon parking, double parking, double-parking, self-parking, valet parking
    Parking in central London can be very difficult.
    • 1960 December, “The Glasgow Suburban Electrification is opened”, in Trains Illustrated, page 715:
      Glasgow's car-parking problem is one of the worst in the country and the frequency of the new electrified rail service ought to attract a big clientele from the city's close-packed suburbs.
    • 1948, Report of the Charlotte Parking Survey: Downtown Business District:
      Table 6 represents an analysis of the parking usage in the Downtown Business District, in terms of the number of parkings, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., according to Type of Facility used, and the Purposes of the Trips […]
  4. Space in which to park a car or other vehicle, such as a parking lot or curbside parking.
    Hyponyms: parking lot, parking garage
    Near-synonyms: car park, carpark
    ample parking;   parking in rear
    Each one of his parkings of securities was a separate count on the indictment.
    (as gerundial noun)
    It can be difficult to find parking in central London.
    They found his car in a parking thirty miles away; apparently it had been stolen by a joyrider.

Usage notes

[edit]
  • Often used attributively, as an adjective.

Cebuano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From English parking, from park (“to park”), from Middle English park, from Old French parc (“livestock pen”), from Medieval Latin parcus, parricus, from Frankish *parrik (“enclosure, pen”), from Proto-Germanic *parrukaz (“enclosure, fence”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Hyphenation: par‧king

Verb

[edit]

parking

  1. to park; to bring (something such as a vehicle) to a halt or store in a specified place
    • 2007 — Gaspar, Karl, Biyaheng-Hapsay Aron Di Magkagidlay (21 November), Panaw-Lantaw, MindaNews
      Kaniadto bisan asa lang moparking ang maong mga sakyanan ug walay klarong ka-adtoan ang mga pasaherong nanginahanglan og CR.
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)
    • 2011 November 24, Batuto, Brenda; Rey Pasaporte, “Carnapper Nadakpan”, in Banat News:
      Sa pakisusi sa Banat News sa Guadalupe Police Station nasayran nga ang maong motorsiklo giparking ni Miranda sa daplin sa karsada niadtong Lunes sa ala 1:00 sa hapon apan nawagtang kini kay gidagit sa wala hiilhing karnapper, busa gi-report dayon niya ngadto sa Guadalupe Police Station.
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)
    • 2014 — Lastimosa, Leo, Raket sa Clamping (13 May), Arangkada, The Freeman
      Gihimong ebidensiya ang nadakpan sa mga operatiba sa City Traffic Operations Management nga sakyanan sa City Hall nga giingong giparking og kadlawong dako duol sa imnanan sa downtown area.
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)
    • 2015 April 15, Pepito, John Paul V, “Taxi Driver Nag-park, Nadasmagan”, in SuperBalita Cebu:
      Taxi drayber nga nagparking sa sakyanan atubangan mismo sa punerarya sa U.N. Avenue, Brgy. Alang- Alang, dakbayan sa Mandaue namatay human maligsi og sakyanan kagahapon sa kaadlawon.
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)
    • 2016 — Pareja, Gerard, Magamit unta ang CICC sa IEC (27 January), Salins Hulbot, Opinion, Cebu Daily News
      Unsa naman sab ni ang akong nadawat nga estorya nga ipatuman gyud sa management sa Qimonda IT Center nga pabayran na ang ilang parking area sa mga buot mo-parking[sic]?
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)

[edit]
  • parkinganan
